rows: Archives survive unequally and are not neutral mirrors of the past.
Quellenkritik predates Ranke and later expands beyond written documents.
Historicism is methodological caution, not "all claims are equal."
Perspective cannot be transcended; it must be disciplined and disclosed.
Political history of rulers, diplomacy, war, treaties
This misses social, economic, gender, colonial, and material structures.
The model exported unevenly and does not fit all historical archives.
`Wie es eigentlich gewesen` as interpretive discipline
Ranke was not naive about interpretation.
